docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
ls /opt/keycloak/lib/app | head
for j in /opt/keycloak/lib/app/*.jar; do
  unzip -l "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages_de.properties" && echo "FOUND $j"
done' 2>&1
